newsitem.title: USA: Manhattan Bagel converts nine Ohio stores.
newsitem.headline: Manhattan Bagel converts nine Ohio stores.

text.p: Manhattan Bagel Co Inc said on Tuesday it converted nine Ohio units, which previously operated under the Bagel Brothers name, to Manhattan Bagel franchises.

Seven units were located in the Cleveland region and the other two were in the greater Akron area, the company said. The stores were among the 23 Bagel Brothers units that Manhattan Bagel added to its franchise network in June.
In July, a class action lawsuit was filed against Manhattan Bagel, alleging the company concealed and misrepresented details of its operations, which caused it to restate results.
